name: dsh-default-workspace
description: DeepSeek Harness opens every new Session in a default Workspace that it pins to <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace — on Windows the system drive — and never relocates. This plugin inspects, repairs, and relocates that Workspace at runtime: it rewrites the Workspace record in the running Host, optionally moves the directory contents, and relocates or re-frames stored Session logs that still point at the old path.
